items.name: Intent/geometry
items.basis: Input shapes are validated (pydantic models, validator.py) before COM calls, but nothing checks created or edited geometry against requested values or saved specifications.
items.scope_and_limits: No readback of created entities, no dimension-vs-geometry check, no tamper detection. Draw ops return the handle as success without reading the entity back. Partial transform failures are reported with the full requested count.

deduction.reason: Withhold 5: no verified implementation of intent/geometry checking.

items.name: Delivery
items.basis: manage_files save writes via COM Document.SaveAs and returns a path.
items.scope_and_limits: Serious false success (source-demonstrated): files.py _save reports path=output_dir/filename (or the caller's filepath), while file_mixin actually saves to output_dir/drawings/<name>.<format> (resolve_export_path adds the 'drawings' subfolder and an extension), so the returned path can name a file that was not written. format=dxf/pdf only changes the filename extension; SaveAs is called without SaveAsType and PDF has no plot path, yet the op reports 'Drawing saved'. No readback, hashes, version or per-format scope. No committed results, logs of tool calls, benchmarks or completed test CI exist for this commit or its ancestors (only gh-pages deployment runs 23094624408/23107086677, which build docs). Without output/behavioral evidence the anchor caps this item at 1.

deduction.reason: Withhold 4: no output evidence; no delivery gate/readback; reported save path and format are not a verified postcondition (the serious defect would cap at 2 regardless).

declared_contract: A Windows-only Python MCP server (FastMCP, v0.2.0) that drives a running AutoCAD, ZWCAD, GstarCAD or BricsCAD over COM (pywin32) through seven shorthand batch tools: drawing primitives/dimensions/leaders/tables, layers, entity selection and transforms, blocks and attributes, file new/save(dwg/dxf/pdf)/close/switch, session/view/undo/screenshot, and entity data export to JSON/Excel, plus a local web dashboard. No headless/DXF backend and no domain or engineering-standards workflows are claimed.

serious_defects.description: manage_files save reports success and a path that is not where the file is written: _save returns output_dir/filename or the caller's filepath, while save_drawing writes to output_dir/drawings/<name>.<fmt> via resolve_export_path (and appends an extension). format=dxf/pdf only changes the extension; SaveAs is called without a SaveAsType and PDF has no plot path, yet 'Drawing saved' is returned.
move/rotate/scale return success=True with count=len(handles) when only some handles were transformed (adapter returns moved_count > 0; per-handle failures only logged).
Shipped config.json sets output.allow_arbitrary_paths=true, disabling the path-traversal guard by default; HTTP mode exposes MCP and dashboard POST endpoints without authentication.

limitations: No code from the repository was executed (untrusted); defects are source-demonstrated, not reproduced against a CAD application.
The exact AutoCAD/ZWCAD behaviour of Document.SaveAs with a .dxf/.pdf name and no SaveAsType was not tested; the path-mismatch half of the C3 defect does not depend on it.
Without any output evidence every item is capped at 1 by the rubric, so the defects did not lower the scores; they are recorded for when evidence appears.
Published scores of this repository (including U-C4N's) were not consulted.
